content.text: When `field` is `None` (i.e., the route declares no `response_model`/response field), `serialize_response` skips validation and field-based serialization entirely and simply returns `jsonable_encoder(response_content)` — converting the raw endpoint return value to a JSON-compatible form without any pydantic validation, without applying `include`/`exclude`/`by_alias`/`exclude_unset`/`exclude_defaults`/`exclude_none` options, and without the possibility of raising a `ResponseValidationError` (see the `else` branch in `fastapi/routing.py`, lines 340-341).
